exposure: Airway liquid volumes (normal ~10 ml/kg vs. elevated ~30 ml/kg)
cohort: Spontaneously breathing near-term newborn lambs (n=17) delivered via caesarean section.
finding: Elevated airway liquid volumes at birth in near-term lambs led to higher inspired oxygen requirements, reduced activity and feeding, increased respiratory morbidity scores, and adverse breathing patterns associated with respiratory distress, particularly in males.
